about: Camera moves as words. kind static/move lets the prompt check catch a locked camera and a move in one prompt. A preset with a lora names it by pattern: when a matching LoRA is installed the studio offers it and adds the trigger (never in a part with dialogue: H3 speaks trigger words).

framings.name: Close two-shot
framings.text: Close medium two-shot from the chest up, the camera is close so both faces are large in the frame

framings.name: Close-up
framings.text: Close-up from the shoulders up, the face fills a large part of the frame

framings.name: Medium shot
framings.text: Medium shot from the waist up

framings.name: Full shot
framings.text: Full shot, the whole body from head to feet in frame with space around it

framings.name: Wide shot
framings.text: Wide shot that shows the whole place, the people small in the frame

framings.name: Over the shoulder
framings.text: Over-the-shoulder shot: the back of one person's shoulder and head in the foreground on the edge of the frame, the other person's face clearly visible

framings.name: Low angle
framings.text: Low-angle shot from near the ground looking up

framings.name: High angle
framings.text: High-angle shot looking down from above head height

framings.name: Point of view
framings.text: First-person point-of-view shot, the hands of the person in the lower part of the frame

framings.name: Insert
framings.text: Close insert shot of the object, sharp, filling the frame

framings.name: Car, through the windshield
framings.text: Seen from outside through the windshield by a camera on the hood, the windshield glass clean and clear

moves.name: Locked-off
moves.text: Static shot on a locked, still camera

moves.name: Handheld, in place
moves.text: Handheld camera that stays in place with a slight natural shake

moves.name: Slow push-in
moves.text: The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the subject

moves.name: Pull-back reveal
moves.text: The camera pulls back slowly and steadily, revealing more of the place

moves.name: Truck left
moves.text: The camera moves sideways to the left at a steady pace, parallel to the subject

moves.name: Truck right
moves.text: The camera moves sideways to the right at a steady pace, parallel to the subject

moves.name: Dolly zoom
moves.text: Dolly zoom: the camera moves back while the lens zooms in, the subject stays the same size while the background stretches away

moves.name: Pan left
moves.text: The camera pans slowly to the left from a fixed position

moves.name: Pan right
moves.text: The camera pans slowly to the right from a fixed position

moves.name: Tilt up
moves.text: The camera tilts up slowly from a fixed position

moves.name: Tilt down
moves.text: The camera tilts down slowly from a fixed position

moves.name: Whip pan
moves.text: The camera whip-pans fast to the side with motion blur and settles on the new subject

moves.name: Follow from behind
moves.text: Steadicam tracking shot that follows the subject from behind at walking speed

moves.name: Lead from the front
moves.text: The camera moves backward in front of the subject at the subject's speed, so the face stays large and clearly visible

moves.name: Side tracking
moves.text: Tracking shot that moves alongside the subject at the same speed

moves.name: Vehicle chase
moves.text: Fast tracking shot moving alongside the vehicle at its speed, low to the road

moves.name: Crane up
moves.text: Crane shot that rises smoothly from eye level to high above the scene

moves.name: Crane down
moves.text: A slow aerial crane shot descending from above the rooftops down to street level, ending in a wide shot

moves.name: Drone rise
moves.text: Drone shot that rises and pulls away, the subject getting smaller in a wide landscape

moves.name: Drone fly-over
moves.text: Smooth drone shot flying forward over the scene at a steady height

moves.name: FPV fly-through
moves.text: Fast first-person drone shot that dives and flies through the scene close to the ground

moves.name: Orbit left
moves.text: The camera orbits slowly around the subject to the left, the subject stays in the centre of the frame

moves.name: Orbit right
moves.text: The camera orbits slowly around the subject to the right, the subject stays in the centre of the frame

moves.name: Half orbit
moves.text: The camera performs one smooth 180-degree orbit around the subject, from the front around to the back

moves.name: Bullet time
moves.text: At the peak of the action time slows almost completely: everything stays frozen in mid-air while the camera performs a smooth 180-degree orbital movement around it, every position and spatial relationship kept; then time snaps back to normal speed
moves.note: Works best written as timed phases: 0.00-3.00s the run-up, 3.00-7.00s bullet-time with the orbit, 7.00-10.00s back to normal speed.

moves.name: Slow zoom in
moves.text: The lens zooms in slowly on the subject, the camera position stays fixed

moves.name: Slow zoom out
moves.text: The lens zooms out slowly, the camera position stays fixed

moves.name: Crash zoom
moves.text: Crash zoom: the lens snaps in fast on the subject's face

moves.name: Rack focus
moves.text: The focus shifts from the foreground to the subject in the background, the camera stays still

motion_lora.note: A camera-motion LoRA makes named moves happen more reliably. With two more LoRAs keep the strengths around 1.2-1.3 in total: three at full strength on the 8-step turbo made moving objects ghost.
